evidence.r1: Glass is confined to brand navigation, section navigation, configuration, reservation and the lens menu; specification cards are opaque.
evidence.r2: The lens menu opens above the configuration bar without overlapping it, and its selected option uses a neutral fill.
evidence.r3: The separate Sable One brand plaque adds a glass island without an evident control role alongside the navigation.
evidence.r4: The navigation, configurator and lens menu share a dark smoky regular-glass appearance.
evidence.r5: No clear-glass variant is visible; the floating surfaces are dark and diffusely frosted.
evidence.r6: Only Reserve carries a tinted background, while finish and lens selections use neutral fills.
evidence.r7: The normal navigation and configurator show diffuse background variation and become flatter grey in the reduced capture.
evidence.r8: The bars and specification cards use fixed rounded corners, while Reserve is a capsule.
evidence.r9: The selected lens row is almost edge-to-edge but its large rounded corners do not follow the menu corner centres.
evidence.r10: The bordered SX 45 mm lens trigger is a rounded rectangle rather than a capsule.
evidence.r11: Brand and navigation form two top groups; configuration and Reserve form two bottom groups.
evidence.r12: The navigation and configurator use text buttons; lens glyphs accompany text options rather than separate icon buttons.
evidence.r13: The material spans the full navigation and configuration controls, not their inner labels.
evidence.r14: Finish and lens controls share one configurator while the primary action is deliberately separated beside it.
evidence.r15: The scrolled sensor and body text passes under the bottom configurator without any visible scroll-edge fade or boundary.
evidence.r16: In the scrolled captures the configurator lies across the uniform opaque specification cards.
evidence.r17: The sensor heading overlaps the top navigation region and body copy sits behind the bottom configurator in the scrolled views.
evidence.r18: The dark bars have subdued labels and no light-state capture establishes the required contrast in both modes.
evidence.r19: The reduced-transparency controls remain available, but increased-contrast and reduced-motion states are not demonstrated.
evidence.r20: Camera, sensor and lens photography fills the viewport behind the floating navigation and purchase controls.
evidence.r21: The sensor heading and lower specification copy fail to clear the floating bars in the scrolled captures.
evidence.r22: The glass navigation and lens menu show material rims without a distinct additional background panel beneath them.
evidence.r23: The lens-menu still does not reveal whether it morphs from the trigger or how presses respond.
evidence.r24: Navigation and configuration labels are monochrome, with reservation colour carried by its background.
evidence.r25: Pale configurator and navigation labels remain distinct from the dark glass over the photographs and olive cards.
